integrity: The unrestricted formula is proved using 3-adic Cantor support gaps and explicit distinct-window arguments; finite brute-force checks are corroboration, not an infinite proof.
limitations: Specific one-sided fixed point of the binary Cantor substitution, at all positive factor lengths. No claim for other substitutions, finite iterates, or shift-optimized non-repetitive complexity. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Complete initial non-repetitive complexity of the binary Cantor word
